title: BIMEXEC T0A capability matrix
description: Output contract of bimexec/probes/probe_t0a.py. Every capability must carry backend attribution; supported is a tri-state: true = CERTIFIED by a real call, false = proven NOT available, null = UNKNOWN (never treat as OK). The matrix is measured evidence, not documentation: nothing may be treated as supported unless this file says supported = true.

version.description: Probe version that produced this matrix.

archicad.description: Identity of the Archicad instance the probe actually spoke to.

discovery.description: Read-only port scan: which API port answered and with which project. An entry with _error did not answer.

backends.description: Availability of each backend that was tried.

capabilities.description: One entry per probed capability. Every entry MUST declare which backend supplied the answer.

supported.description: true = certified by a real call; false = proven unavailable; null = UNKNOWN, must fail closed.

backend.description: Backend attribution: 'tapir', 'mcp', or null when no backend could answer.

evidence.description: Raw measured evidence. Shape is capability-specific; it is the audit trail and must not be empty for supported = true.

marker_carriers_readable.description: Marker carriers that were actually read: 'element_id', 'property'.

duplicate_detection.description: SCAN_PREFIX = duplicate detection by client-side scan of property values + prefix match. EMPTY_SCOPE_FALLBACK = property values cannot be read at all, so no search is possible and every mutating op must be blocked. NONE = not determined.

operations.description: Per-operation production-safety gate consumed by the executor.

raw_dumps.description: Unmodified responses kept for manual inspection. GetDetailsOfElements_sample is the evidence for wall endpoint geometry (begCoordinate / endCoordinate).

t0b_candidates.description: Wall GUIDs offered as --guid input for T0B.

executed.description: true only means the probe ran. It is NOT a go decision: the decision is t0a_go.
